parameters.NOTES: TODO P1-6 / FNM-1. Identical to the `cross-sectional` job in every respect except FEATURE_NORMALIZE: 'cs_rank' -> 'none'. Same payload dataset (the panel is byte-identical), same universe, target, horizon, lookback, min_width, dtype and ensemble, so the only thing that moves is the FEATURE REPRESENTATION the selection scores under. The question: the selection kept its 13 channels while ranking each feature within its date before windowing, but train_test_creator feeds the model those channels GLOBALLY STANDARDISED - two different representations, and CLAUDE.md section 5 rule 1 says a bar computed for one configuration says nothing about another. If the same channels survive under 'none', the mismatch is moot and the sentence 'built on a shortlist that cleared z = +9.09' is safe; if they do not, that sentence is withdrawn. NO NULL on purpose - the kept SET is the measurement here, not its bar, which is what took PRF-7 from ~6 h to 10m 34s. feature_normalize is already in contract.SETUP_KEYS, so this run groups APART from the cs_rank runs and cannot be unioned into one table by accident.

The PDF parse on a Kaggle T4. VCB Q1-2026 is the test case because all three of its statements already read `pdf` at `onnx@200` on this machine, from the consolidated filing - so the run has an exact baseline and `compare()` scores every cell against it. The question is NOT whether the quarter parses (it does, here); it is whether a T4 with Kaggle's own torch and onnxruntime reproduces the same LAYER and the same FIGURES. Run 1 (2026-08-28, 83.8 s) reproduced all 98 cells - and its log showed DB detection had fallen back to the CPU, because a bare `onnxruntime-gpu` resolves to 1.29.0 which needs CUDA 13 against Kaggle's 12.8. onnxruntime-gpu is pinned to the CUDA 12 line (1.20.1, this repo's own version) and the notebook now reports what the SESSION holds rather than what get_available_providers() advertises. Nothing is written back to the statement CSVs either way.

THE HARD DOCUMENT. VCB Q1-2026 accepted at layer 1 of 47, so it measured the integration and not the cascade. BID Q4-2016 is the opposite pole and it is the hardest filing this repo has on disk: the FY-2016 audited consolidated ANNUAL report, 5.0 MB, whose balance sheet and income statement accept at `onnx@200` while its CASH FLOW needs `onnx@200+pad6+annual+extra` - layer 45 of 47, three separate defects deep (a detector box that ends INSIDE the number, an annual report that dates its cash tail by the YEAR where the schema names the PERIOD, and a fourth reconciling term the bank chart of accounts has no column for: the MHB merger cash). `_parse_cascaded` breaks only when all three statements are accepted, so ONE unresolvable statement makes the other two pay the whole cascade - CLAUDE.md section 6-2-decies' bimodal cost, and the ~10 distinct OCR passes are what a T4 is actually for. Locally the four-period run that recovered this quarter took 35m 20s. THE INCOME STATEMENT WILL NOT BE SCORED and that is correct: an annual filing prints a CUMULATIVE P&L and the row on disk has been de-cumulated, so `compare()` refuses it rather than reporting every cell as changed.

VIC Q1-2026 on a T4, INTERLEAVED with a local run of the same document started the same minute. The previous local-vs-T4 comparisons were taken hours apart and were withdrawn when two further local runs of one document came in 2.25x faster with nothing recorded to explain it (CLAUDE.md 6-2-sexvicies) - interleaving is the fix. This document is the WORST case for a GPU: 47 of 47 layers entered, 22 fresh OCR passes over 71 pages and 25 cached re-maps, because the income statement is never found and `_parse_cascaded` only breaks when all three are accepted. TEMPLATE is stated rather than resolved so both machines take the same route. Nothing here may be quoted as a fundamental: CRP-1.

VIC Q3-2014 on a T4 — the FIRST cross-machine check on a quarter that FAILS. Every comparison so far (VCB Q1-2026, BID Q4-2016, VIC Q1-2026) was a filing that ends with three accepted statements, so what was measured was reproduction of an ACCEPT. This quarter's balance sheet and income statement are `missing` on disk after all 47 layers and only its cash flow parsed (onnx@200), so the run reproduces a REFUSAL — every gate verdict, every escalation and the same two absences, or it does not. Locally it took 44m 33s inside the 27-quarter authoritative run (CLAUDE.md 6-2-duotricies). The filters are the `quarters` parameter INTERSECTED with `periods`: quarters=[2014-Q3] and periods=[Q3-2014] select one filing, which is what exercises the new code path without paying for four documents. TEMPLATE is stated rather than resolved so both machines take the same route. `sane` gets a real magnitude band because the payload ships the statement CSVs and 26 earlier VIC quarters sit in them — this is NOT a subset run in the sense that flips the guard open, because pdf_ocr_job seeds the band from disk and writes no CSV. Nothing from this run may be quoted as a fundamental: CRP-1.
